# Kaizen Supplies Ltd

> Kaizen Supplies Ltd is a creative marketing agency based at Plot 12 Malcolm X Ave, Kololo, Kampala, Uganda. The agency helps organizations build lasting brands through strategy, storytelling, content creation, digital marketing, photography, video, live production and experiential campaigns.

- [Home](https://www.kaizensuppliesltd.com/): Overview of Kaizen Supplies Ltd and its services.

- [Work](https://www.kaizensuppliesltd.com/work.html): Selected client campaigns, creative projects and media productions.
- [Kaizen Chat](https://www.kaizensuppliesltd.com/Kaizen-Chat/): WhatsApp business automation for instant customer replies, lead capture and shared team inbox workflows.
- [Contact](https://www.kaizensuppliesltd.com/contact.html): Contact details and enquiry form.

## Kaizen Chat

Kaizen Chat is a product of Kaizen Supplies Ltd for businesses that serve customers through WhatsApp. It provides instant, business-approved replies, captures customer names and enquiries, shares approved information such as prices, opening hours, locations and payment details, and keeps conversations organised for a team.

- Product type: WhatsApp business assistant and customer-service automation platform
- Primary market: Businesses in Uganda
- Core capabilities: instant replies, enquiry capture, official WhatsApp Business number support, shared team inboxes, quick replies, catalog tagging and business app integrations
- Published plans: Baby at UGX 20,000 per week, Starter at UGX 75,000 per month and Business at UGX 150,000 per month; enterprise pricing is tailored
- Setup: Approximately three to five working days after the required business information is supplied
- Contact: info@kaizensuppliesltd.com
